title: Enquirer’s Guide: Who is an Eidetician?
author: The Enquirer’s Guide Desk
paragraphs: This entry from The Enquirer’s Guide answers a question often put to the Society: “Who is an Eidetician?”

Some work with lenses and measuring plates; others survey its layers, tend receiving instruments, examine returned objects, or report the findings. The field contains disagreements as vigorous as any other science.

Readers should treat the answer as an introduction rather than a final authority. Eidetic science in Alderwick is reported through measurements, disputed interpretations and careful revisions, and a respectable enquiry may properly end with further questions.
